description:
**Image Description**

This image presents a close-up view of a bidet attached to a toilet, situated on the right side of the frame against a dark red wall. The bidet features a white ceramic body, a silver faucet with a knob on top, and two circular cutouts near the top. A silver handle is situated at the bottom of the bidet, while a white cord hangs from the right side.

In the background, a brown wall provides a subtle contrast to the white bidet
